step: 4 | missing: whether same-day delivery is offered

cases.text:
Unfortunately, that's not something covered in our current policies, so I'm unable to confirm whether same-day delivery is offered.

What I can tell you is that our fastest available shipping option, per **kb/02-shipping-policy.md**, is **Overnight delivery** (next business day), available for $24.95 when you order by 1 PM local time.

If you have further questions about shipping or need help with an order, feel free to reach out — we're happy to help!
